artifact_inventory.description: Full-precision certificate matrices P1..R3 plus stored worst coupling margin

domain: switched delay systems with unstable modes under MDADT
limitations: Computational (numpy eigvalsh) verification, not interval-rigorous; thin absolute margins (~1e-4 LMI, ~2.7e-5 coupling); delay-derivative bound tau=0.2 inferred from d(t)=0.2 sin t; improvement is within the fixed LMI class and rates.
provenance: Independent SCOPE audit of lane-1486 attempt-1; certificate matrices from research inputs; LMI/coupling values independently recomputed; Hou-Zong 2018 paper full text and fused literature search checked.
record_title: Improved in-class MDADT certificate (0.5493, 0.1808, 0.2231) for the Hou-Zong 2018 unstable-delay benchmark
